final: WITH mix_counts AS (SELECT t.ordertypedist AS order_type_mix, COUNT(DISTINCT t.transreg) AS transaction_count FROM advancedbehavior AS a JOIN transactionrecord AS t ON a.translink = t.transreg GROUP BY t.ordertypedist), mix_shares AS (SELECT order_type_mix, transaction_count, 1.0 * transaction_count / SUM(transaction_count) OVER () AS share FROM mix_counts) SELECT order_type_mix, transaction_count, share, share - (SELECT AVG(share) FROM mix_shares) AS above_baseline FROM mix_shares WHERE share > (SELECT AVG(share) FROM mix_shares)
